clusters.label: Steep learning curve
clusters.summary: Users repeatedly describe a steep, discouraging learning curve when starting out.

clusters.label: Slow with large databases
clusters.summary: Users report sluggish performance and slow loading on large or complex pages and databases.

clusters.label: Overwhelming to build workflows/databases
clusters.summary: Users find setting up sustainable databases, templates, and workflows from scratch intimidating and time-consuming to teach others.

clusters.label: Overwhelming customization options
clusters.summary: Users feel the sheer number of customization options and features is overwhelming, particularly for newcomers.

clusters.label: Complex, overwhelming UI
clusters.summary: Users find Notion's interface complex and overrated, requiring a lot of tinkering to get organized rather than just working.

clusters.label: Tables weaker than Excel
clusters.summary: Users want database/table features (formulas, charts, spreadsheet functions) closer to Excel or Google Sheets.

clusters.label: Mobile app slower than desktop
clusters.summary: Users say the mobile app is noticeably less smooth, slower to load, and less full-featured than the desktop version.

clusters.label: Offline mode too limited
clusters.summary: Users say offline functionality is minimal and full use still requires a reliable internet connection.

clusters.label: Difficult initial setup
clusters.summary: Users find the initial setup process tricky, time-consuming, and front-end-heavy to get right.

clusters.label: Want more styles and formatting
clusters.summary: Users wish for more themes, fonts, color choices, text formatting, and canvas/mood-board options.

clusters.label: Limited permissions and paid-gated features
clusters.summary: Users cite restrictive database/version-history permissions and useful features (like PDF export) being locked behind paid plans.

clusters.label: Offline mode unreliable
clusters.summary: Users describe offline mode as barely functional or untrustworthy, effectively locking them out when connectivity drops.

clusters.label: AI features cost extra
clusters.summary: Users resent paying an additional premium for AI on top of a paid plan, especially since free AI prompts run out quickly and other tools bundle it for free.

clusters.label: Lacks third-party integrations
clusters.summary: Users want better compatibility with tools like Microsoft, Google Suite, and CRMs, and note gaps like the API not supporting image uploads.

clusters.label: Premium pricing too high
clusters.summary: Users find premium/subscription plans expensive relative to value, especially for individuals, small teams, or mass adoption.

clusters.label: Search and AI accuracy issues
clusters.summary: Users find search results inaccurate and the AI sometimes misunderstands prompts, goes down, or hits character limits in code blocks.

clusters.label: PDF import/export formatting bugs
clusters.summary: Users report broken formatting, cut-off columns on PDF export, and issues importing files including size limits.
